references.notes: LEGACY — do not use for a new site. Retained only so sites already built on it still have their shape documented. firefly has no <form> anywhere in its source: it ships GHLFormEmbed alone and captures a lead only if a human pastes a GHL snippet during site-generate. On an unattended build nobody does, and the result is a complete, good-looking site that cannot capture a lead. Was `role: primary` here, which kept pulling builds back onto it after the skill default had already changed to owl.

The default template, and the structural reference for every new site. Section order: hero (full-bleed media + floating quote card) → promise bar → services grid with category labels + sub-service lists → testimonials → promise band → signature system (intro + sub-blocks + numbered steps + guarantee) → 4-step process strip on a dark band → about with checklist → long-form SEO body with a second checklist → FAQ → recent-articles row → closing CTA. READ THE LOCAL TEMPLATE, not a third-party site: the structure is already encoded here, it costs nothing to read, and it cannot drift or 404. Deliberately absent by design: sticky side-rail quote tab, floating quote popup, video-testimonial blocks. Structure is reusable; COPY IS NOT. Branded program names — any named 'system', 'guarantee' or 'promise' block — belong to whoever coined them and must never reach a generated site. Every component here is content-driven and ships no default copy, so each client supplies its own naming.

AGC Concrete — original inspiration for the editorial type treatment, section rhythm, and real-photography approach. Use as backup reference when Firefly's URL is unreachable or when a client wants a distinctly editorial aesthetic vs Firefly's brighter cyan-accented direction.

anti_patterns: purple / indigo / violet accents (unless explicitly requested)
generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats, generic hard-hat closeup)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
